name: Boon Of Desperate Resilience
description: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+) You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 30.

features.name: Defense of Body and Mind
features.description: While you are Bloodied, you have Resistance to every damage type except Force.
